column1: # GBIF backbone -> AviList name bridge. Generated by cmd/birdview-gbifmap.
# gbif scientific name<TAB>gbif species key<TAB>avilist scientific name<TAB>tier
# Scope: every species the eBird Observation Dataset (doi:10.15468/aomfnb)
# reports from the US and Canada. Names and synonymy from the GBIF Backbone
# tier=exact     GBIF's accepted name is an AviList species name
# tier=synonym   one GBIF synonym of it is
# tier=epithet   one AviList species in the same family shares the epithet,
#                after folding gender agreement and Latin genitive endings
# tier=ambiguous more than one corresponded, so none was chosen
# A resolved row says the two authorities use different names for one taxon.
# It does NOT say their species CONCEPTS agree. Where GBIF has not followed a
# split, its name maps to whichever half kept the name, and the occurrences
# behind it are mostly the other half: GBIF's Circus cyaneus maps to AviList's
# Circus cyaneus, the Eurasian Hen Harrier, and 3.8 million of those records
